contracts.input_semantics: One typed EH18HandoffRequest bound to the single-tank profile in Garden v15.7 [T-EH-18], including estimated state/error, remaining uncontrolled delay, epoch, authority, fallback, transfer, actuator, dependency, timing and resource dispositions.
contracts.output_semantics: Exactly one EH18HandoffReceipt with a closed candidate-only disposition. ELIGIBLE_FOR_BOUNDED_SIMULATION authorizes no effect and is not SAFE, PASS, proof, certification or deployment admission. Every noneligible disposition blocks composed command admission; failures expose that a qualified minimum-risk response is required but unresolved, without selecting an action.
contracts.error_semantics: Malformed numeric inputs return MALFORMED with command evaluation not performed; stale epoch, missing authority, unqualified fallback, untrusted state/actuator, violated assumptions, assurance loss and outside-recoverable-region conditions remain distinct. A narrow epoch/authority subcheck cannot compose to ACCEPTED when another handoff prerequisite fails or is unknown.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Incomplete timing/dependency evidence returns OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; unresolved resource bounds return RESOURCE_UNKNOWN. Neither may become eligible by confidence, retry or wording.
contracts.effect_semantics: Pure deterministic reference calculation. It performs no actuation, state mutation, authority change, canonical promotion, provider call or deployment action.
proof_obligations: CCC-001..010 and canonical containment/handoff rules remain unchanged
continuous-time and interval threshold proof remains independent work
real timing, actuator dynamics, common-cause independence and solver-error evidence remain independent work
minimum-risk action selection requires a declared loss function and qualified domain safety case; this reference records that frontier and selects no action
fresh authorization is required before primary return
positive reference result is never represented as deployment safety
